metadata.subject: Information Technology
metadata.topic: Database Concepts — Primary Key, Relationships, Design View, Datasheet View
metadata.caribbean_note: Caribbean agricultural context: FARMERS and FARM tables with Caribbean crops (Banana, Orange, Irish potato, Lychee, Sweet pepper) and regional farmer data
metadata.note: Q1d(i): 1 mark (primary key). Q1d(ii): 2 marks (linked fields). Q1d(iii): 4 marks (Design View fields and tables). Q1d(iv): 3 marks (Datasheet View result). FARMERS has: ID, FirstName, LastName, Gender, Contact, Region. FARM has: FarmID, Crop, Cost Per Produce, FarmerID. FarmerID 1 = Jack Smith, Region 1, with Banana (002) and Orange (192).

question.name: CSEC IT May 2025 Q1d — Database Query Design and Results
question.text:
Consider the following database with two tables:

FARMERS

ID No.FirstNameLastNameGenderContact NumberRegion
1JackSmithM675-87421
2LeslieJacobsF782-67342
3BruceJordanM892-67641
4KarenSmithF323-87927
5LindaDanielsF239-05522
6JeromeLevyM982-12915
7CarlingtonNicholsM767-22315
8HandelBrownM773-22314

FARM

FarmIDCropCost Per ProduceFarmerID
002Banana$10.001
192Orange$8.251
778Irish potato$30.006
252Lychee$25.002
123Sweet pepper$15.005
question.general_feedback:
(i) Primary key in FARM: FarmID — uniquely identifies each record in the FARM table.

(ii) Linked fields for relationship: FARMERS.ID No. linked to FARM.FarmerID — these form the foreign key relationship between the two tables.

(iii) Design View for query (Farmer's full name, Region, Crop, FarmID where FarmerID = 1):
Field: FirstName | LastName | Region | Crop | FarmID | FarmerID
Table: FARMERS | FARMERS | FARMERS | FARM | FARM | FARM
Show: ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | □
Criteria: | | | | | 1

(iv) Datasheet View result:

FirstNameRegionCropFarmID
Jack1Banana002
Jack1Orange192

Two records returned because FarmerID 1 (Jack Smith) has two entries in the FARM table.

steps.label:
Tables: FARMERS (ID No., FirstName, LastName, Gender, Contact, Region)  |  FARM (FarmID, Crop, Cost, FarmerID)
Task: Identify primary key → link tables → design query → produce results for FarmerID = 1
Part (i) — Identify the primary key of the FARM table. (1 mark)
Part (ii) — State the two fields that must be linked to create a relationship between the tables. (2 marks)
Part (iii) — Complete the Design View to query Farmer's full name, Region, Crop and FarmID where FarmerID = 1. (4 marks)
Part (iv) — Complete the Datasheet View showing the query results. (3 marks)

fields.label: Primary key of FARM table: _____
fields.diagnostic_hint: The primary key uniquely identifies each record. In FARM, each FarmID (002, 192, 778, 252, 123) is unique.

error_codes.SC_METHOD_ERROR: The primary key must be unique for every record. In FARM, FarmID is the only field that never repeats — FarmerID repeats (FarmerID 1 appears twice).

fields.label: Field from FARMERS table used to link: _____
fields.diagnostic_hint: The FARMERS table identifies each farmer by their ID No. — this must match with a field in FARM.

error_codes.SC_METHOD_ERROR: The primary key of FARMERS is ID No. — this links to the foreign key in FARM.

fields.label: Field from FARM table used to link: _____
fields.diagnostic_hint: FarmerID in the FARM table is the foreign key that links to ID No. in FARMERS.

error_codes.SC_METHOD_ERROR: FarmerID in FARM matches ID No. in FARMERS — this is the foreign key relationship.

fields.label: Design View — Field(s) for farmer's full name: _____
fields.diagnostic_hint: Full name requires FirstName and LastName fields, both from the FARMERS table.

error_codes.SC_METHOD_ERROR: To display a full name in a query, include both FirstName and LastName from the FARMERS table. They appear as separate columns in the Design View.

fields.label: Design View — Fields for Region and Crop (state field and table for each): _____
fields.expected: Region from FARMERS, Crop from FARM
fields.diagnostic_hint: Region comes from FARMERS; Crop comes from FARM. Each field must be paired with its correct table in the Design View.

error_codes.SC_METHOD_ERROR: Region belongs to the FARMERS table; Crop belongs to the FARM table. In Design View, each column shows: Field name above and Table name below.

options.Region from FARMERS, Crop from FARM: Region from FARMERS, Crop from FARM
options.Region from FARM, Crop from FARMERS: Region from FARM, Crop from FARMERS
options.Both Region and Crop from FARMERS: Both Region and Crop from FARMERS
options.Both Region and Crop from FARM: Both Region and Crop from FARM

fields.label: Design View — FarmID field and FarmerID criteria (state the criteria value): _____
fields.diagnostic_hint: FarmID (from FARM) is displayed. The Criteria row for FarmerID must be set to '1' to filter for Jack Smith's farms only.

error_codes.SC_METHOD_ERROR: Add FarmerID to the query, uncheck its Show box, and set Criteria = 1. This filters all FARM records to only those belonging to FarmerID 1.

fields.label: Design View — Table names for name/Region fields: _____
fields.diagnostic_hint: FirstName, LastName, and Region all come from the FARMERS table.

error_codes.SC_METHOD_ERROR: The Table row in Design View must say FARMERS for FirstName, LastName, and Region columns.

fields.label: Datasheet View — Row 1 result (name, Region, Crop, FarmID): _____
fields.diagnostic_hint: FarmerID 1 = Jack Smith, Region 1. First farm: FarmID 002, Crop = Banana.

error_codes.SC_METHOD_ERROR: Filter FARM for FarmerID = 1 → Jack Smith (FARMERS row 1) linked to FarmID 002 (Banana) and FarmID 192 (Orange). Row 1: Jack | Smith | 1 | Banana | 002.

fields.label: Datasheet View — Row 2 result (name, Region, Crop, FarmID): _____
fields.diagnostic_hint: FarmerID 1 has two farm records — second record: FarmID 192, Crop = Orange.

error_codes.SC_METHOD_ERROR: FarmerID 1 appears twice in FARM (FarmID 002 and 192). The query returns 2 rows. Row 2: Jack | Smith | 1 | Orange | 192.
